articles.title: Key questions as Infantino faces Fifa executives
articles.summary: Fifa president Gianni Infantino will face senior leaders of football's world governing body on Wednesday. This is what is expected to happen.

articles.title: Draper in tears amid injury concern during defeat in Montreal
articles.summary: Jack Draper was left in tears after losing to Terence Atmane as the Brit's long-term arm injury appeared to resurface and hamper him on his return to action at the Canadian Open.

articles.title: Infantino to hold crisis meeting with senior FIFA staff
articles.summary: Under-pressure FIFA president Gianni Infantino will hold a crisis meeting with senior staff in Morocco on Wednesday.
